issue.description: Search results are bad. Make product search better and faster so users find what they want.

verifiedFacts: searchProducts matches only the product name, as a case-insensitive substring
Results are sorted by name and capped at 20
SearchBox runs a search on every keystroke, without a debounce
The ticket has no acceptance criteria
mustStayUncertain: What "better" results means (ranking, typo tolerance, which fields to search)
A speed target, and whether search is actually slow
Which queries or users fail today
forbiddenClaims: A specific latency or response-time target as a requirement
Fuzzy or typo-tolerant matching as a confirmed requirement
Search being slow stated as a verified fact
